QuestInfo.name: Nella's Fifth Request
QuestInfo.0: Nella has a new job for you.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate Crocos at in the #m103030200# territory and bring Croco Skins to the Dark Lord. You might want to see if JM has the same job for you...
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Croco Skins to the Dark Lord.

0.0: I've got a really urgent job for you. I need you to eliminate 100 Crocos in the #m103030200# territory and take 50 Croco Skins to the Dark Lord. Simple, right?

yes.0: Great! Hurry along, then! By the way, you ditch JM yet? He'll only hold you back, you know.

no.0: You sure? You don't want to tick off the Dark Lord, do you?

1.0: You're the one Nella hired? You've been training, haven't you? Why, you're almost strong now. So, did you finish the task?

yes.0: Excellent. I'll see you soon... Now leave.

npc.0: Hurry! The Dark Lord is waiting!

item.0: You don't have the Croco Skins yet?
